_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. On an Android TV or TV box, as a Customer display: the remote's left and right change the adverts, OK opens the settings (after a manager's PIN), and up and down move between buttons. A lime ring always shows where you are. 2. Customer display, Settings, Display options: new sections Big screen, Adverts, While a bill is on screen, Tiles, When the till goes quiet, What the customer reads, Paying. Try film sound, pictures fill the screen, bill on the left or right, tiles along the bottom or down the side, and a thank-you of your own. 3. Kitchen mode on a TV: the board name at the top and 'see the whole ticket' can be reached with the remote. 4. On a TV box, any key wakes the idle screen.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on a TV works with the remote everywhere: arrows move, OK presses, and the customer display changes adverts and opens its settings from the remote. The customer display has every option of the Windows customer display: advert timing, sound and fit, the bill's side and size, tiles, the idle time, your own thank-you, message and QR, full screen and which way up.
